tagline.en_US: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser made for people, with love. Privacy-first with unbiased ad-blocking.

description.en_US: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and ad-blocking. It provides a familiar navigation experience while blocking intrusive trackers and advertisements without bias. It can be accessed remotely through a streaming web interface to browse external or local network services within an isolated environment.
